item.title: Watch: CJP volunteers attempting to inspect Rajasthan govt school attacked
item.summary: Cockroach Janta Party volunteers faced alleged assault by BJP workers during a school inspection. CJP co-convenor Ashutosh Ranka reported injuries and damage to vehicles and phones. Villagers prevented the CJP team from visiting the school, citing local capabilities. They also opposed the CJP's views and campaign for school improvements. The incident occurred as the CJP continues its 'School Thik Karo' campaign.
